spans.s: (prob. corrupted fr. वेत्र; but See Uṇ. iii, 118) a cane, reed, L.
= वेतन, L.
(cf. वितण्ड, वेदण्ड, वेग-दण्ड) an elephant, Hcar.; Kād.; Bhām.
a form of Durgā, Vās. (v.l. for वेताला).
(accord. to Uṇ. iii, 150 fr. √ वी, but rather connected with √ वृत्; cf. वर्तन) wages, hire, salary, subsistence, livelihood, Mn.; MBh. &c.
price, Rājat.
silver, L.
वेतन—जीविन् mfn. subsisting by wages, stipendiary, MW.
वेतन—दान n. the paying of wages, hiring, Pāṇ. i, 3, 36, Sch.
non-payment of wages, Mn. viii, 218.
वेतन—भुज् m. ‘earning wages’, a servant, Pañcar.
receiving wages, stipendiary (mostly ifc., e.g. कुप्य-व्˚, receiving bad pay), MBh.
(cf. वेत and वेत्र) the ratan (Calamus Rotang) or a similar kind of cane, a reed, rod, stick, RV. &c. &c.
the citron (Citrus Medica), MW.
N. of Agni, ib.
a lancet shaped like a pointed leaf of the ratan, Vāgbh.
N. of a city, Kathās.

etym.s: [cf. accord. to some, Gk. ἰτέα; Lat. vitis; Germ. wîda, Weide; Eng. withy.]

spans.s: (ई), f. the ratan, cane, reed, Kathās. (˚सी-तरु, Sāh.)
वेतस—गृह n. an arbour formed of reeds, Śak.
वेतस—पत्त्र n. the leaf of the ratan, MārkP.
a lancet, W.
वेतस—परिक्षिप्त mfn. (an arbour) fenced or enclosed by reeds, Śak.
वेतस—पुष्प n. the blossom of the ratan, VarBṛS.
वेतस—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of reeds, Hcar.
वेतस—मालिन् mfn. wreathed with reeds, Ml.
वेतस—वृत्ति mfn. acting or pliant as a reed, Pañcat.
वेतस—शाखा॑ f. a branch of reed, ŚBr.
Rumex Vesicarius, L.
pl. N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. चेत्˚)
N. of a place, ib.
N. of a river, VP. (cf. वेदसिनी).
N. of a man or of an Asura (pl. his descendants), RV.
abounding in reeds, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 87
N. of a place, PañcavBr.
= ˚वत्, Hir.
(of doubtful derivation) a kind of demon, ghost, spirit, goblin, vampire (esp. one occupying a dead body), Hariv.; Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
N. of one of Śiva's attendants, KālikāP.
of a teacher, BhP.
of a poet, Cat.
a door-keeper (?), L.
a form of Durgā, Vās.
N. of Durgā, Hariv.
वेताल—कर्म-ज्ञ mfn. knowing the doings of a Vetāla, VarBṛS.
वेताल—कवच n. N. of a Kavaca (q.v.), Cat.
वेताल—जननी f. N. of one of the Mātṛs attendant on Skanda, MBh.

वेताल—पञ्च-विंशति or वेताल—पञ्च-विंश˚तिका, f. a collection of 25 tales or fables told by a Vetāla or demon to king Vikramāditya (of which there are 5 recensions extant, one by Kṣemendra in his Bṛhat-kathā-mañjarī, one by Soma-deva in the Kathā-sarit-sāgara, and the other three by Jambhala-datta, Vallabha, and Śiva-dāsa ; versions of these popular tales exist in Hindī, Tamil and Telugu, and almost every Hindū vernacular).

वेताल—पञ्च-विंशति or वेताल—पञ्च-विंश˚तिका, f. a collection of 25 tales or fables told by a Vetāla or demon to king Vikramāditya (of which there are 5 recensions extant, one by Kṣemendra in his Bṛhat-kathā-mañjarī, one by Soma-deva in the Kathā-sarit-sāgara, and the other three by Jambhala-datta, Vallabha, and Śiva-dāsa ; versions of these popular tales exist in Hindī, Tamil and Telugu, and almost every Hindū vernacular).
वेताल—पुर n. N. of a town, Siṃhās.
वेताल—भट्ट m. N. of a poet (the author of the Nīti-pradīpa, and one of the 9 men of letters said to have flourished at the court of Vikramāditya; cf. नव-रत्न), Cat.
वेताल—रस m. a partic. mixture, L.
वेताल—विंशति f. N. of a collection of 20 Vetāla tales by Veṅkaṭa-bhaṭṭa.
वेताल—साधन n. winning or securing (the favour of) a Vetāla, Kathās.
वेताल—सिद्धि f. the supernatural power of a Vetāla, Buddh.
वेताल—स्तोत्र n. N. of a Stotra.
N. of wk.
a kind of posture (in which the right hand holds the toe of the left foot, and the left hand holds the toe of the right foot), L.
the act of raising a Vetāla, Mālatīm.
1. वेत्तृ mfn. (fr. √ 1. विद्) one who knows or feels or witnesses or experiences, a knower, experiencer, witness, ŚvetUp.; MBh. &c.
a sage, one who knows the nature of the soul and God, W.
2. वेत्तृ m. (fr. √ 3. विद्) one who obtains in marriage, an espouser, husband, Āpast.
वेत्तृ—त्व n. knowledge, MW.
n. (accord. to Uṇ. iv, 166, fr. √ 1. वी; prob. connected with √ 1. वे cf. वेणु) a kind of large reed (used for making sticks, prob. Calamus Rotang or Fasciculatus), Kauś.; MBh. &c.
a cane, staff, VarBṛS.; BhP.; MaitrUp., Sch.
the rod or mace of an officer, staff of a door-keeper (see comp.)
the tube of a flute, Saṃgīt.
वेत्र—करीर m. n. the shoot or fresh sprout of a reed, Suśr.
वेत्र—कार m. a worker in reed, R.
वेत्र—कीचक-वेणु m. pl. different sorts of reed, BhP.
वेत्र—ग्रहण n. ‘grasping the staff’, the office of a door-keeper, Ragh.
वेत्र—दण्डिक m. ‘reed-staff bearer’, a door-keeper, L.
वेत्र—धर m. ‘staff-bearer’, a door-keeper, L.
वेत्र—धरा f. a female door-keeper, Ragh.
वेत्र—धारक m. = -धर, L.
वेत्र—धारिन् m. ‘staff-bearer’, the servant of a great man, Pañcad.
वेत्र—नदी f. N. of a river, Divyāv.
वेत्र—पाणि m. ‘staff-handed’, a mace-bearer, Hariv.
वेत्र—फल n. the fruit of Vetra, Suśr.
वेत्र—भृत् m. = -धर, Dharmaś.
वेत्र—यष्टि f. a staff of reed or cane, Śak.
वेत्र—लता f. ‘reed-branch’, a staff or stick, Pañcat.
वेत्र—लता—चय m. a heap of sticks, R.
वेत्र—लता—मय mf(ई)n. made of sticks, Hcar.
वेत्र—वत् mfn. containing or consisting of reeds, BhP.
वेत्र—वत् m. N. of a mythical being (a son of Pūṣan), Kathās.
वेत्र—वती f. a female door-keeper, Śak.; Prab.
a form of Durgā, Hariv. (v.l. चित्र-रथी)

N. of a river (now called the Betwā, which, rising among the Vindhya hills in the Bhopāl State and following a north-easterly direction for about 360 miles, falls into the Jumnā below Hamīrpur), MBh.; R. &c.
of the mother of Vetrāsura, VarP.
N. of a river, Cat. (cf. वेत्र-वती and Vām. v, 2, 75).
वेत्र—वन-माहात्म्य n. N. of wk.
वेत्र—व्यासक्त-हस्त mfn. one whose hands cling to a reed or reeds, MBh.
वेत्र—हन् m. N. of Indra, L. (prob. w.r. for वृत्र-हन्).
वेत्र—हस्त m. = -पाणि, Kathās.
the point of a reed, Suśr.
a blow with a cane, a caning, MW.
id., Kautukas.
= वेतसाम्ल, Suśr.
‘cane-seat’, a small oblong low couch of cane-work (used as a dooly or litter)
वेत्रास˚नासीन mfn. seated on such a seat, Kum.
the juice or decoction of Vetra, Suśr.
N. of an Asura, VarP. (v.l. वैत्र्˚).
reedy, abounding with reeds or canes, g. नडादि
a reedy place, Pāṇ. vi, 4, 153, Sch.

pl. N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. वेणिक).
having a cane, having anything for a cane, MaitrUp.
a staff-bearer, door-keeper, Rājat.
